title: Inventory: Bloom et al. 2015 (Nature Communications 6:8712) supplementary information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/bloom2015/raw/`: every item listed under
static-content.springer.com, plus the article page (`sources/bloom2015/article.html`). Nature's
PowerPoint copies of the main figures are not supplementary data and were not downloaded.
Checksums are in `MANIFEST.tsv`. Faithful extractions made from these files are in `extracted/`:
`markers.tsv` (the 28,220 genotype-matrix column names from Supplementary Data 5, which the
`index` columns of Supplementary Data 3 and 4 refer to; written by `extracted/extract_markers.py`)

roles.41467_2015_BFncomms9712_MOESM724_ESM.pdf: Supplementary Information: Supplementary Figures 1-5 (power curves, simulations, interaction variance partition, effect sizes of QTL-QTL pairs, background-linkage controls). Figures only; not parsed.
roles.41467_2015_BFncomms9712_MOESM725_ESM.xls: Supplementary Data 1: simulation results for genetic architectures with given numbers of additive QTL and QTL-QTL pairs, and the variance-component estimates (A+E and A+AA+E models). Kept verbatim in docs/v/b15_extra.json.
roles.41467_2015_BFncomms9712_MOESM726_ESM.xls: Supplementary Data 2: variance-component analyses per trait (repeatability, error, additive, two-way and three-way interaction terms, with standard errors, for several models). Kept verbatim in docs/v/b15_extra.json.
roles.41467_2015_BFncomms9712_MOESM727_ESM.xls: Supplementary Data 3: detected additive QTL (797): chromosome, trait, marker index, forward-search peak position, lm coefficient, variance explained, refineqtl peak and 1.5-LOD interval, max LOD, interval size and the genes in the interval. Core input.
roles.41467_2015_BFncomms9712_MOESM728_ESM.xls: Supplementary Data 4: detected QTL-QTL interactions, full two-dimensional scan (205) and marginal scan (266), FDR 10%: marker indices and positions of both loci, LOD, lm coefficient, variance explained, closest additive QTL and how many partners are not additive QTL. Kept verbatim in docs/v/b15_extra.json.
roles.41467_2015_BFncomms9712_MOESM729_ESM.zip: Supplementary Data 5: segregant genotypes (gdata, 4,390 x 28,220, -1 BY / 1 RM) and phenotypes (pheno_raw, 20 traits, two replicates) as RData objects inside two nested zips. Checksummed and listed (extracted/supp_data_5_contents.tsv); only the marker names are extracted. No genotype or phenotype value is copied into the atlas.

missing: No trait doses: the 20 trait names carry no concentration, and the article says phenotyping was 'as described previously' (Bloom et al. 2013). See OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.
No genome-wide LOD profiles for the reported QTL (the genotype and phenotype matrices in Supplementary Data 5 would allow recomputing them; the atlas does not).
No rule for matching full-scan and marginal-scan interactions (the text's '172 detected by both' cannot be reproduced exactly).
No statement of the scale of lm_coefficient beyond the -1/1 genotype coding of Supplementary Data 5.
